name: Sarah M.
text: This is so helpful! I always wondered if there was an actual difference between my son's cries or if I was just imagining things. The frequency breakdown finally makes sense of what I've been hearing for the past 3 months.

name: James T.
text: Honestly, my daughter's cry sounds like ALL of these at once. Maybe I need to get my hearing checked lol.

name: Rebecca K.
text: The hunger cry section was a game changer for me. I was overfeeding because I couldn't tell the difference between hungry and tired. Thanks for breaking this down so clearly!

name: David L.
text: Has anyone else found that their baby's cry doesn't fit into these categories? My newborn seems to have his own unique pattern that doesn't match what's described here.

name: Monica P.
text: I wish I had read this during my first week home from the hospital. Would've saved me so much stress and second-guessing myself.
